verdict.rationale: BugSnag documents its own sensitive-data management tooling for redacting or removing sensitive data, aimed at GDPR/CCPA/HIPAA compliance. That tooling is explicitly retroactive, so it acts after payloads have persisted. The SDK-side evidence covers only `before notify` callbacks and discard rules that drop whole events by criteria, not field-level PII redaction. Missing for 10: server-side scrubbing rules applied at ingestion before persistence, documented SDK-level field redaction/filtering of PII (e.g. redacted keys), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
